test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The music / blared out / and was impossible / to have a conversation.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **and was impossible**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We have to add** "it" **before and to make the sentence correct.
 
• **It** is the third-person singular personal pronoun. It is often used to refer to animals or non-living things.
 
• We commonly use the pronoun** it **as both a subject and an object pronoun:
 
• **Example -** 
 
 
• *Don't drink the milk. **It **smells terrible.*
 
• ***It **was cold, so we lit a fire. *
 
 
 
• Without **"it" **the given sentence does not make any sense.
 
• So, the correct answer is** option 2.**
 
• **Corrected sentence: ***The music blared out and it was impossible__ to have a conversation.*
